steps.title: Consultation
steps.desc: We begin by understanding your vision, requirements, budget and site conditions through a comprehensive initial consultation.

steps.title: Design & Planning
steps.desc: Our architects develop detailed 2D plans, 3D renders and cost estimates — all reviewed and approved by you before we proceed.

steps.title: Construction
steps.desc: Our certified team executes the build with precision, providing regular site updates and progress photos at every milestone.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.desc: Multi-stage quality audits at structural, roofing and finishing phases ensure every standard is met before proceeding.

steps.title: Handover
steps.desc: Your completed project is handed over with full documentation, warranties and post-construction support.
